+"""Tests for tasks_api.queries — TaskQuery validation and apply_query."""
+
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
+
+import pytest
+
+from tasks_api.models import Tag, Task, TaskPriority, TaskStatus
+from tasks_api.queries import TaskPage, TaskQuery, TaskQueryError, apply_query
+
+NOW = datetime(2025, 6, 1, 12, 0, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+
+
+def _task(tid, title="t", status=TaskStatus.PENDING, priority=TaskPriority.MEDIUM,
+          due_at=None, tags=None, created_at=None):
+    return Task(
+        id=tid, title=title, status=status, priority=priority,
+        due_at=due_at, tags=tags or [],
+        created_at=created_at or NOW,
+    )
+
+
+# ── TaskQuery validation ───────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+class TestTaskQueryValidation:
+    def test_defaults_are_valid(self):
+        q = TaskQuery()
+        assert q.sort == "created_at"
+        assert q.limit == 20
+        assert q.offset == 0
+
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize("field", ["created_at", "due_at", "priority", "title"])
+    def test_valid_sort_fields(self, field):
+        q = TaskQuery(sort=field)
+        assert q.sort == field
+
+    def test_invalid_sort_field_raises(self):
+        with pytest.raises(TaskQueryError, match="sort must be one of"):
+            TaskQuery(sort="bogus")
+
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize("bad_limit", [0, -1, 101, "x"])
+    def test_invalid_limit_raises(self, bad_limit):
+        with pytest.raises(TaskQueryError, match="limit"):
+            TaskQuery(limit=bad_limit)
+
+    def test_negative_offset_raises(self):
+        with pytest.raises(TaskQueryError, match="offset"):
+            TaskQuery(offset=-1)
+
+    def test_tag_normalised(self):
+        q = TaskQuery(tag="  MyTag  ")
+        assert q.tag == "mytag"
+
+    def test_invalid_tag_raises(self):
+        with pytest.raises((TaskQueryError, ValueError)):
+            TaskQuery(tag="bad tag!")
+
+    def test_search_whitespace_stripped(self):
+        q = TaskQuery(search="  hello  ")
+        assert q.search == "hello"
+
+    def test_search_blank_becomes_none(self):
+        q = TaskQuery(search="   ")
+        assert q.search is None
+
+
+# ── apply_query filtering ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+class TestApplyQueryFiltering:
+    def test_filter_by_status(self):
+        tasks = [_task(1, status=TaskStatus.PENDING), _task(2, status=TaskStatus.DONE)]
+        page = apply_query(tasks, TaskQuery(status=TaskStatus.DONE), NOW)
+        assert [t.id for t in page.items] == [2]
+        assert page.total == 1
+
+    def test_filter_by_tag(self):
+        tasks = [
+            _task(1, tags=[Tag("python")]),
+            _task(2, tags=[Tag("rust")]),
+            _task(3, tags=[Tag("python"), Tag("flask")]),
+        ]
+        page = apply_query(tasks, TaskQuery(tag="python"), NOW)
+        assert {t.id for t in page.items} == {1, 3}
+
+    def test_filter_by_search(self):
+        tasks = [_task(1, title="Buy milk"), _task(2, title="Read book")]
+        page = apply_query(tasks, TaskQuery(search="milk"), NOW)
+        assert [t.id for t in page.items] == [1]
+
+    def test_search_is_case_insensitive(self):
+        tasks = [_task(1, title="Buy Milk")]
+        page = apply_query(tasks, TaskQuery(search="buy"), NOW)
+        assert len(page.items) == 1
+
+    def test_filter_overdue_true(self):
+        overdue_task = _task(1, due_at=NOW - timedelta(hours=1))
+        future_task = _task(2, due_at=NOW + timedelta(hours=1))
+        page = apply_query([overdue_task, future_task], TaskQuery(overdue=True), NOW)
+        assert [t.id for t in page.items] == [1]
+
+    def test_filter_overdue_false(self):
+        overdue_task = _task(1, due_at=NOW - timedelta(hours=1))
+        future_task = _task(2, due_at=NOW + timedelta(hours=1))
+        page = apply_query([overdue_task, future_task], TaskQuery(overdue=False), NOW)
+        assert [t.id for t in page.items] == [2]
+
+    def test_no_filters_returns_all(self):
+        tasks = [_task(i) for i in range(5)]
+        page = apply_query(tasks, TaskQuery(), NOW)
+        assert page.total == 5
+
+
+# ── apply_query sorting ────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+class TestApplyQuerySorting:
+    def test_sort_by_created_at(self):
+        t1 = _task(1, created_at=NOW - timedelta(hours=2))
+        t2 = _task(2, created_at=NOW - timedelta(hours=1))
+        t3 = _task(3, created_at=NOW)
+        page = apply_query([t3, t1, t2], TaskQuery(sort="created_at"), NOW)
+        assert [t.id for t in page.items] == [1, 2, 3]
+
+    def test_sort_by_created_at_descending(self):
+        t1 = _task(1, created_at=NOW - timedelta(hours=2))
+        t2 = _task(2, created_at=NOW)
+        page = apply_query([t1, t2], TaskQuery(sort="created_at", descending=True), NOW)
+        assert [t.id for t in page.items] == [2, 1]
+
+    def test_sort_by_due_at_none_last(self):
+        t1 = _task(1, due_at=NOW + timedelta(hours=1))
+        t2 = _task(2, due_at=None)
+        t3 = _task(3, due_at=NOW - timedelta(hours=1))
+        page = apply_query([t1, t2, t3], TaskQuery(sort="due_at"), NOW)
+        ids = [t.id for t in page.items]
+        assert ids[-1] == 2  # None is last
+        assert ids[0] == 3   # earliest first
+
+    def test_sort_by_priority(self):
+        t_low = _task(1, priority=TaskPriority.LOW)
+        t_high = _task(2, priority=TaskPriority.HIGH)
+        t_med = _task(3, priority=TaskPriority.MEDIUM)
+        page = apply_query([t_low, t_high, t_med], TaskQuery(sort="priority"), NOW)
+        assert [t.id for t in page.items] == [2, 3, 1]  # HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW
+
+    def test_sort_by_title_case_insensitive(self):
+        t1 = _task(1, title="banana")
+        t2 = _task(2, title="Apple")
+        t3 = _task(3, title="cherry")
+        page = apply_query([t1, t2, t3], TaskQuery(sort="title"), NOW)
+        assert [t.id for t in page.items] == [2, 1, 3]
+
+
+# ── apply_query pagination ─────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+class TestApplyQueryPagination:
+    def _tasks(self, n):
+        return [_task(i, created_at=NOW + timedelta(seconds=i)) for i in range(1, n + 1)]
+
+    def test_limit(self):
+        page = apply_query(self._tasks(5), TaskQuery(limit=2), NOW)
+        assert len(page.items) == 2
+        assert page.total == 5
+        assert page.has_more is True
+
+    def test_offset(self):
+        page = apply_query(self._tasks(5), TaskQuery(limit=2, offset=3), NOW)
+        assert len(page.items) == 2
+        assert page.has_more is False
+
+    def test_offset_beyond_total(self):
+        page = apply_query(self._tasks(3), TaskQuery(offset=10), NOW)
+        assert len(page.items) == 0
+        assert page.total == 3
+        assert page.has_more is False
+
+    def test_has_more_exactly_at_boundary(self):
+        page = apply_query(self._tasks(5), TaskQuery(limit=5), NOW)
+        assert page.has_more is False
+
+    def test_page_attributes(self):
+        page = apply_query(self._tasks(10), TaskQuery(limit=3, offset=2), NOW)
+        assert page.limit == 3
+        assert page.offset == 2
+        assert page.total == 10
+
+
+# ── TaskPage.has_more ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+class TestTaskPageHasMore:
+    def test_has_more_true(self):
+        page = TaskPage(items=[_task(1)], total=5, limit=1, offset=0)
+        assert page.has_more is True
+
+    def test_has_more_false_at_end(self):
+        page = TaskPage(items=[_task(1)], total=1, limit=1, offset=0)
+        assert page.has_more is False
+
+    def test_has_more_false_empty(self):
+        page = TaskPage(items=[], total=0, limit=10, offset=0)
+        assert page.has_more is False
+
